name: light__apple_dim_via_move_to_level
description: Apple ships a LevelControl.MoveToLevel (cluster 0x0008, command 0x00) invoke with the target Level (uint8) inside the command-fields struct. The bridge MUST decode the Level field and forward it to the cluster server's MatterInvoke as a uint8 (or a typed request struct extractMoveToLevel recognises). Catches the regression where commandFieldsReader silently drains every non-commissioning cluster's command fields and surfaces nil — produces an UnsupportedAttribute / InvalidCommand status instead of actually dimming the lamp. Phase-X-class: Apple-driven dim against a real LevelControl cluster server on a single_onoff_endpoint_source-style topology stand-in. The fake source returns its own DataVersion bump as proof the write applied. Live-reproduced bug: HmIP-BDT Küchenstrahler accepts 100% and 0% (routed via OnOff) but ignores intermediate levels because MoveToLevel's Level field never reaches the cluster server.
